summary: I started using my Open Source time to #IndieWeb after 8 years of working with Mozilla Foundation. They shut down their learning efforts. Decided I only wanted to contribute to open source where A: there was no Board or bosses, and B: community members could lead
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I started using my Open Source time to #IndieWeb after 8 years of working with Mozilla Foundation. They shut down their learning efforts.

Decided I only wanted to contribute to open source where A: there was no Board or bosses, and B: community members could lead
